usage: 椒鹽魷魚 can be used as the subject of a sentence when talking about food.
You can use 椒鹽魷魚 as the object if you are ordering or expressing a desire to eat it.
椒鹽魷魚 works well with verbs related to cooking or eating, like 食 (to eat) or 煮 (to cook).
You can describe 椒鹽魷魚 with adjectives to talk about taste or texture, for example, 好味 (delicious) or 香口 (fragrant).
When offering or recommending food, 椒鹽魷魚 often appears with phrases like 推介 (recommend) or 想試 (want to try).
